Under R7, the agent must not block the card, but instead execute CREATE_CASE + VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER + WARN_CUSTOMER. The draft incorrectly applies R2 and blocks the card.

events.what_would_change_verdict: Change the applied rule from R2 to R7. Remove the BLOCK_CARD action and add VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER and WARN_CUSTOMER (both auto routes). Ensure the specialist summaries only rely on the provided evidence.
